programmes.d: An Indian causes gold fever to break out in Dodge City when he pays for the funeral of a slain friend with a 350 gold piece.
A gunrunner gets the Pawnees mad in order to sell his weapons.
A dying storekeeper's last word is Matt's only clue to finding the man who killed him.
Marshal Dillon is forced to send to prison a man he believes innocent of the crime for which he will be hanged. (TV-PG)
Matt and Chester act as decoys to ambush outlaws that are masking their crimes as those of renegade Indians.
Matt gets suspicious of a land agent's generous offer.
A convicted murderer's brother runs against Matt for marshal.
Revengeful night riders from Missouri invade Dodge City and challenge the authority of deputy Festus Haggen.
Matt must prove his innocence when he is accused of beating a man to death.

Dodge City merchants celebrate the end of a round-up and unite against any acts of violence.

A gunman tries to start a fight with a braggart.
An impoverished widower is accused of stealing money from a bank in order to feed his two small children.
A saloon girl withdraws into bitterness when a jealous hunter kills the man she loves. (TV-PG)
A rancher blames Doc for the death of his wife.
A run on the Dodge City bank forces three desperate farmers to resort to robbery.
Kitty Russell, injured and isolated by a stagecoach accident, must rely on a strange wild child to help her survive.
